name: Freighter
description: A wallet for holding Stellar assets and connecting to Stellar applications.
regionNotes: Availability depends on the app store and your location.
networkNotes: Stellar; confirm the selected network in your wallet.

name: StellarX
description: A trading interface for the Stellar decentralized exchange and liquidity pools.
regionNotes: Product and asset availability depend on the provider and your jurisdiction.
networkNotes: Stellar mainnet; check the exact asset issuer before trading.

name: MoneyGram Ramps
description: Cash-in and cash-out infrastructure for Stellar USDC through supported wallets and participating locations.
regionNotes: Participating locations, supported wallets and identity requirements vary. Confirm availability with MoneyGram.
networkNotes: Stellar USDC; provider documentation also covers other networks. Select Stellar explicitly.

name: Stellar RPC
description: Documentation for querying Stellar network data and submitting transactions through RPC.
regionNotes: Endpoint providers set their own availability and service limits.
networkNotes: Mainnet, testnet and local networks; choose a matching endpoint.

name: Stellar Lab
description: Build, sign, simulate and submit transactions, and explore Stellar APIs.
regionNotes: Browser-based tooling; individual network and provider availability varies.
networkNotes: Supports multiple Stellar networks. Use testnet for experiments.

name: Sevio Ad Manager
description: The advertising integration used for banners on the homepage, asset pages and explorer guides.
regionNotes: Campaign and ad availability vary by location and device.
networkNotes: Advertising service; independent of the selected Stellar network.
